# SETTING A WORKING DIRECTORY
```{r}
 setwd("C:/Users/ADMIN/OneDrive/Desktop/caleb makini")

```


# load libraries
```{r}
library(cluster)
library(factoextra)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
```

# load data
```{r}
data<-read_excel("mall_customers.xlsx")
head(data)
```


# structure of data
```{r}
str(data)
```

# select numerical features for clastering
```{r}
features <- data[, c("Age",
                   "Annual_Income",
                   "Spending_Score",
                   "Average_Purchase_Value")]
```


```{r}
# scale the data
scaled_feature<-scale(features)
```

# determine the optimal number of clusters
```{r}
fviz_nbclust(scaled_feature,kmeans, method="wss")+
  labs(title="Elbow method for optimal k(multi-feature_data")
```



# apply k-means clustering(setting k=3 based on typical clusters pattern)
```{r}
set.seed(42)
k_optimal<-3
kmean_results<-kmeans(scaled_feature, centers= k_optimal, nstart=25)
```


# view cluster sizes and centers
```{r}
print(kmean_results)
```

# append the clusters assignments back to the origina l data frame
```{r}
data$clusters <- as.factor(kmean_results$cluster)
head(data)
```



# visualize the clasters
```{r}
fviz_cluster(kmean_results, data=scaled_feature,
             pallete=c("red","blue", "yelow"),
             geom="point",
             ellipse.type = "convex",
             ggtheme=theme_minimal(),
             main="Clusters(5- Feature model visualized via PCA)")
```
